name: MS-BDTT: Marine-power-System Bayesian Digital Twin Transfer
description: Reproducibility package for the manuscript 'Digital Twin Transfer for Marine Power Fault Diagnosis via Continuous Domain Interpolation': the confirmatory-analysis kit (ten-seed paired replication, S4 open-set evaluation, measured retention and budget sweeps, identifiability diagnostics, degradation-boundary labelling, partition-leakage audit), the machine-readable results, the regenerated figures, the manuscript and response-letter sources, and the document build pipeline.
